© Imago [...] Harris will, however, remain without Callum Stead, Callum Perry and Shane McLoughlin, who are all sidelined.

Wycombe also emerged from their victory over Notts County without any additional injury concerns and may look to retain the winning formula.

Captain Jack Grimmer is expected to continue at right-back, while Onyedinma and Jayden Wareham are likely to feature in attack as they look to add to the three League One goals they have each scored this season.
